source: Files mode: Transform script (line 46) reads input.ledgacc, balcat, rategrp, cardlink as strings (IO02, lines('ledgacc') etc.); daytxn, clntrec, crdrec, txntype, txncatg accepted but not used (IO03); businessDate and accrueParameter with defaults (TX03). Package outputs (line 52): output={accrueResult:{accrue_systxn, accrue_ledgacc, assumptions, assumptions_md, status}}. Script is one line in the definition, so every build flag cites line 46 and names its register entry.
build: CAL02/ERR04: calculation join and fallback rate not specified; missing rates give no charge
CAL03: no period, annualization or formula supplied; assumed balance x rate / 1200
CAL04: rounding and posting granularity unspecified; truncation assumed per category
CAL04/CAL05: zero charges omitted; no rules for zero or negative balances and rates
CAL06: posting behaviour not specified; current balance and cycle debit increased
TX01/TX03: interest transaction values and timestamp construction not specified
TX02: sequencing, parameter composition and exhaustion policy not specified
